Rape
(Incidence…2,532 Rate…0.2)
A total of 2,532 child rape cases were reported in the country during the year compared to 2,113 such cases in
2001 accounting for a significant increase of 19.8 per cent during the year. Madhya Pradesh (517) contributed 20.4 per
cent of such cases at National level. The rate of crime was, however, highest in Delhi (1.0) compared to 0.2 at the
National level.
Kidnapping & Abduction
(Incidence…2,322 Rate…0.2)
A total of 2,322 cases of Kidnapping & Abduction of children were reported during the year compared to 2,845
cases in the previous year accounting for a significant decline of 18.4 percent during the year. Uttar Pradesh (539)
contributed 23.2 per cent of such cases at the National level. The rate of crime was the highest in Delhi at 3.0
compared to the National average rate of 0.2 only.
Foeticide
(Incidence…84)
A total of 84 cases of Foeticide were reported in the country during the year compared to 55 cases in the
previous year accounting for significant increase of 52.7% during the year. Delhi reported 20 cases out of 84 cases
reported in the country contributing 23.8% of the total cases.
Abetment of Suicide
(Incidence…24)
Following the last year’s trend, 24 cases were reported during 2002 as compared to 26 cases in 2001. Andhra
Pradesh reported more than half (54.2%) cases by reporting 13 out of 24 such cases at the National level.
Exposure & Abandonment
(Incidence…644 Rate…0.1)
A total of 644 cases were reported during the year as compared to 678 cases in the year 2001, representing
5.0% decrease during the year. Maharashtra reported 282 cases contributing 43.8% of the total cases at the National
level.
Procuration of Minor Girls
(Incidence…124)
Compared to 138 such cases in 2001, 124 cases were reported in the year 2002, accounting for 10% decline
over 2001. More than one-fourth (27.4%) cases were reported from Maharashtra State alone (34).
Buying/Selling of girls for Prostitution
(Incidence…9/5)
Only 9 cases of Buying of girls for prostitution and 5 cases of `Selling of girls for Prostitution’ were reported in
the country during the year 2002. Comparatively, in the year 2001, 6 cases of Buying of girls and 8 cases of Selling of
girls for Prostitution were reported in the country.
